subject.title: fix(kimi): use single k3 wire id with 1M catalog context

question: Should OpenClaw advertise Kimi K3's provider-maximum 1M context to every `kimi/k3` account, accepting server-side entitlement failures for lower tiers, or retain a lower safe default until an entitlement-aware path exists?
rationale: The upstream API requires the unified `k3` wire ID, but the correct local context limit depends on an account membership tier that this PR does not detect; that user-visible provider policy cannot be inferred safely from tests alone.

options.title: Accept provider-maximum catalog
options.body: Merge the unified `k3` model at 1M and explicitly accept Kimi's server-side entitlement error as the lower-tier enforcement mechanism.

options.title: Keep safe default
options.body: Retain the 262K catalog limit until the provider has an approved entitlement-aware or explicit opt-in mechanism.

recommendation.title: Accept provider-maximum catalog
recommendation.body: Merge the unified `k3` model at 1M and explicitly accept Kimi's server-side entitlement error as the lower-tier enforcement mechanism.
